newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish yields close mixed, crown loses ground.
newsitem.headline: Swedish yields close mixed, crown loses ground.

text.p: Swedish debt yields closed mixed on Monday. Whilst longer maturities tracked foreign markets higher, the short end fell on expectations of a Riksbank repo rate cut on Tuesday.
A Reuter poll showed that the Riksbank is expected to trim its key rate by 15 basis points down to 5.25 percent.
A cut in key German rates did not have any real implications for Riksbank policy, one analyst said.
"The Bundesbank's repo rate cut does not mean anything per se for Sweden, but it does improve the climate for further rate cuts", he added.
Six-month T-bill rates fell three basis points to 5.12 percent, while nine-year bond yields rose five basis points to 8.07 percent.
The crown softened to 4.4565 against the D-mark compared to 4.4360 late on Friday.

The Riksbank repo-announcement is at 0730 GMT. Next in focus is Swedish July producer price data due at 0800 GMT. The PPI index is expected to decrease by 0.1 percent for the month for a 4.2 percent year on year drop.
